en: Dependent on a state that is without conflict (*araṇa*), acquired (*upādinna*), and subject to clinging (*upādāniya*), there arises a state that is not a refuge (*nasaraṇa*) and is neither acquired nor subject to clinging, by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict, not acquired, and not subject to clinging, there arises a state that is not a refuge and is neither acquired nor subject to clinging, by way of the root condition. Under the root condition: one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.
